observations: Photo 0 shows a black game console with a boxy, two-tone top panel, held up by a hand; a warning/label sticker is visible on the underside but not legible.
Photo 1 shows the same console with one black wireless-style controller (five-button cluster, two sticks, d-pad) placed on top, held by a hand.
No power adaptor/brick, no game discs or cases, and no receipt are visible in either photo.
No close-up of the rear ports, HDMI, or any serial/model plate is shown.
The console is not shown powered on or connected to any display.

identity.kind: game console (seller states Xbox One), with one wireless-style controller

claims.claim: Xbox One with one pad for sale
claims.evidence: No legible brand/model text in photo 0 or 1; controller count matches photo 1 (one pad shown).
No game discs or cases visible in either photo.
No photo of the adaptor or any power-on test; stated fault not visually confirmed but also not contradicted.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No photo of internal screws, seals, or casing edges to confirm it was never opened.
Requires a power-on/run test, not shown.
No close-up of rear port panel in either photo.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads (plural) and UK receipt
claims.evidence: Seller's own opening line says 'with one pad' while later text says 'pads' plural; only one controller is shown in photo 1; no receipt photo provided.

risks.risk: Adaptor fault could mean the console cannot power on at all, not just a minor charging quirk.
risks.proof: A video or photo of the console powered on, showing the home screen on a display.

risks.risk: Unclear whether this is the original 'fat' Xbox One, S, or X variant, which affects value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear panel or bottom label showing the model number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base original Xbox One, the lowest-value variant

risks.risk: Claimed 6 games and FC title are not shown, so bundle value is unconfirmed.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual game discs/cases laid out.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console + controller only, no games included

risks.risk: Port and thermal condition cannot be assessed, so hidden damage (HDMI, overheating history) is possible.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the rear port panel and a short power-on video.
risks.if_unproven: priced as ports/condition unverified, worst case partially faulty

risks.risk: Controller count is inconsistent in the seller's own text, so a second pad may not actually be included.
risks.proof: A photo showing both controllers together if a second one exists.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen, showing the adaptor/cable in frame.
Close-up photo of the rear panel/bottom label showing model number.
Photo of all 6 claimed game discs/cases together with the console.
Photo showing a second controller, if one is actually included.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as an Xbox One console with one controller, but the seller's own disclosed adaptor issue plus the total absence of a power-on, ports, games, or receipt photo means every functional claim must be priced at worst case until proven.
